arxiv-2001-05535.title: The Bhargava greedoid as a Gaussian elimination greedoid
arxiv-2001-05535.creator: Darij Grinberg
arxiv-2001-05535.description: Abstract Abstract. Inspired by Manjul Bhargava’s theory of generalized factorials, Fedor Petrov and the author have defined the Bhargava greedoid – a greedoid (a matroid-like set system on a finite set) assigned to any “ultra triple” (a somewhat extended variant of a finite ultrametric space).

arxiv-2111-15415.title: Establishing the Price of Privacy in Federated Data Trading
arxiv-2111-15415.creator: Kangsoo Jung, Sayan Biswas, Catuscia Palamidessi
arxiv-2111-15415.description: Abstract Personal data is becoming one of the most essential resources in today’s information-based society. Accordingly, there is a growing interest in data markets, which operate data trading services between data providers and data consumers. One issue the data markets have to address is that of the potential threats to privacy.

arxiv-2202-12192.title: A decreasing upper bound of energy for time-fractional phase-field equations
arxiv-2202-12192.creator: Chaoyu Quan, Tao Tang, Boyi Wang, Jiang Yang
arxiv-2202-12192.description: Abstract In this article, we study the energy dissipation property of time-fractional Allen–Cahn equation. We propose a decreasing upper bound of energy that decreases with respect to time and coincides with the original energy at t = 0 t=0 and as t t tends to ∞ \infty .

arxiv-2212-07940.title: A Stress-Strength Reliability Model using Exponential-Gamma ( 3 , λ ) (3,\lambda) Distribution
arxiv-2212-07940.creator: Beenu Thomas, V. M. Chacko, St. Thomas’ College (Autonomous)Thrissur, Kerala, India
arxiv-2212-07940.description: Abstract One of the important problem in reliability analysis is computation of stress-strength reliability. But it is impractical to compute it in certain situations. So the estimation stay as an alternative solution to get an approximate value of the reliability. There are research papers which deals with stress-strength reliability analysis using statistical distributions.

arxiv-2303-16480.title: Quantum interference and controllable magic cavity QED via a giant atom in coupled resonator waveguide
arxiv-2303-16480.creator: Xiaojun Zhang, Chengge Liu, Zhirui Gong, Zhihai Wang
arxiv-2303-16480.description: Abstract We study the Markovian and Non-Markovian dynamics in a giant atom system which couples to a coupled resonator waveguide (CRW) via two distant sites. Under certain conditions, we find that the giant atom population can exhibit an oscillating behavior and the photon can be trapped in the giant atom regime.

arxiv-2310-04825.title: Comparative study of multi-person tracking methods
arxiv-2310-04825.creator: Denis Mbey Akola
arxiv-2310-04825.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Denis Mbey Akola. This paper presents a study of two tracking algorithms (SORT and Tracktor++ ) that were ranked first positions on the MOT Challenge leaderboard 1 1 1 The MOTChallenge web page: https://motchallenge.net . The purpose of this study is to discover the techniques used and to provide useful insights about these algorithms in the tracking pipeline that could improve the performance of MOT tracking algorithms. To this end, we adopted the popular tracking-by-detection approach.

arxiv-2403-16151.title: Ultra Low-Cost Two-Stage Multimodal System for Non-Normative Behavior Detection
arxiv-2403-16151.creator: Albert Lu, Stephen Cranefield
arxiv-2403-16151.description: Abstract The online community has increasingly been inundated by a toxic wave of harmful comments. In response to this growing challenge, we introduce a two-stage ultra-low-cost multimodal harmful behavior detection method designed to identify harmful comments and images with high precision and recall rates.

arxiv-2409-18681.title: Efficient pseudometrics for data-driven comparisons of nonlinear dynamical systems
arxiv-2409-18681.creator: Bryan Glaz
arxiv-2409-18681.description: Abstract Computationally efficient solutions for pseudometrics quantifying deviation from topological conjugacy between dynamical systems are presented. Deviation from conjugacy is quantified in a Pareto optimal sense that accounts for spectral properties of Koopman operators as well as trajectory geometry. Theoretical justification is provided for computing such pseudometrics in Koopman eigenfunction space rather than observable space.

arxiv-2411-06511.title: Time-delayed Dynamic Mode Decomposition for families of periodic trajectories in Cislunar Space
arxiv-2411-06511.creator: Sriram Narayanan, Mohamed Naveed Gul Mohamed, Indranil Nayak, Suman Chakravorty, and Mrinal Kumar
arxiv-2411-06511.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sriram Narayanan, Mohamed Naveed Gul Mohamed, Indranil Nayak, Suman Chakravorty, and Mrinal Kumar. In recent years, the development of the Lunar Gateway and Artemis missions has renewed interest in lunar exploration, including both manned and unmanned missions. This interest necessitates accurate initial orbit determination (IOD) and orbit prediction (OP) in this domain, which faces significant challenges such as severe nonlinearity, sensitivity to initial conditions, large state-space volume, and sparse, faint, and unreliable measurements.

arxiv-2507-00197.title: Preliminary analysis of the annual component of the polar motion over 180-year data interval
arxiv-2507-00197.creator: Natalia Miller, Zinovy Malkin
arxiv-2507-00197.description: Abstract The paper presents preliminary results of studying variations in the annual component in the Earth’s polar motion. For this purpose, a signal with an annual period was extracted, firstly, from the series of pole coordinates of the International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS), and secondly, from the combined series of Pulkovo latitude variations for 1840–2017.

arxiv-2510-15339.title: AutoGraph-R1: End-to-End Reinforcement Learning for Knowledge Graph Construction
arxiv-2510-15339.creator: Hong Ting Tsang, Jiaxin Bai, Haoyu Huang, Qiao Xiao, Tianshi Zheng, Baixuan Xu, Shujie Liu, Yangqiu Song
arxiv-2510-15339.description: Abstract Building effective knowledge graphs (KGs) for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is pivotal for advancing question answering (QA) systems. However, its effectiveness is hindered by a fundamental disconnect: the knowledge graph (KG) construction process is decoupled from its downstream application, yielding suboptimal graph structures.

lady-john-russell-a-memoir-with-selectio.title: Lady John Russell: A Memoir with Selections from Her Diaries and Correspondence
lady-john-russell-a-memoir-with-selectio.creator: Desmond MacCarthy

pmc-11326458.title: Complex Frontal Bone Reconstruction Using Computer-designed Polyetheretherketone Implant: Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-11326458.creator: Yueqi Liu, Shao Xie, Jiahai Ding, Yushun Zhang, Liyi Deng, Yuancheng Yao, Yang Xiong, Yuliang Chen, Lei Wang, Yong Liu
pmc-11326458.description: Summary:Calvarial reconstruction of complex frontal bone defects after head trauma surgery is challenging, especially when it coexists with an absence of eyebrow arch and supraorbital wall. Due to various reasons, the patient’s bone flap could not be used. Common alternative materials include polyetheretherketone (PEEK) and titanium.

pmc-11337575.title: Socioeconomic benefits associated with bats
pmc-11337575.creator: Siya Aggrey, Innocent B. Rwego, Eric Sande, Joyce D. Khayiyi, Robert M. Kityo, Charles Masembe, Rebekah C. Kading
pmc-11337575.description: BackgroundWhile bats are tremendously important to global ecosystems, they have been and continue to be threatened by loss of habitat, food, or roosts, pollution, bat diseases, hunting and killing. Some bat species have also been implicated in the transmission of infectious disease agents to humans.

pmc-11387529.title: Spontaneous multivessel coronary artery dissection associated with microaneurysms in a young women with thyroiditis background: Unusual case report
pmc-11387529.creator: Nouhaila Lahmouch, Omar Nafii, Jamila Zarzur, Mohamed Cherti
pmc-11387529.description: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) is a rare condition that is frequently under-recognized. It has been connected to several triggers and predisposing factors. Interestingly, hypothyroidism has been linked to a higher likelihood of arterial dissections.We present the case of a 49-year-old woman who was admitted for acute coronary syndrome.

pmc-11497486.title: Epidemiological survey of two morphotypes of Demodex folliculorum (Prostigmata: Demodicidade) in young people from southern Spain
pmc-11497486.creator: F.J. Márquez, A.J. López-Montoya, S. Sánchez-Carrión, I. Dimov, M. de Rojas
pmc-11497486.description: Different morphotypes of Demodex from humans have been described. Among them, molecular studies have made it possible to discern between the Demodex folliculorum and Demodex brevis. Further studies showed two morphotypes of D. folliculorum harboured two different habits (human skin and human eyelashes), both of them with finger-shaped terminal opisthosoma difficult to differentiate and that can be assigned to D.

pmc-11618795.title: A landscape of X-inactivation during human T cell development
pmc-11618795.creator: Björn Gylemo, Maike Bensberg, Viktoria Hennings, Christina Lundqvist, Alessandro Camponeschi, Dóra Goldmann, Huan Zhang, Aida Selimović-Pašić, Antonio Lentini, Olov Ekwall, Colm E Nestor
pmc-11618795.description: Females exhibit a more robust immune response to both self-antigens and non-self-antigens than males, resulting in a higher prevalence of autoimmune diseases but more effective responses against infection. Increased expression of X-linked immune genes in female T cells is thought to underlie this enhanced response.

pmc-11715522.title: Multidimensional Modeling of Biological Aging: Integrating Gait, Eye Movement, Rest‐State Functional Connectivity, and Plasma Biomarkers in non Dementia Elderly Individuals
pmc-11715522.creator: Jingyi Lin, Ziyu Ouyang, Tianyan Xu, Lu Shen, Bin Jiao
pmc-11715522.description: BackgroundAging exhibits significant variation among individuals, with biological age as a more reliable predictor of current health status compared to chronological age. Predicting biological age is crucial for facilitating timely interventions aimed at improving the adaptation to the aging process.

pmc-11716581.title: Comparing overall medical costs of operative versus nonoperative treatment for femoral neck fractures among Alzheimer’s disease patients: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11716581.creator: Yijiong Yang
pmc-11716581.description: BackgroundAddressing femoral neck fractures resulting from ground‐level falls in older adults with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) involves a personalized treatment plan, leading to a substantial economic burden on the healthcare system. The debate surrounding the advantages and disadvantages of surgical interventions versus non‐operative approaches for femoral neck fractures in older individuals with AD remains a topic of active discussion.

pmc-12450383.title: Clinical Application of Noninvasive Prenatal Testing in Singleton Pregnancy with and without in vitro Fertilization: A 6-year Observational Study at a Single Tertiary Center
pmc-12450383.creator: Qian Zhang, Yuhong Guo, Bin Liang, Meihuan Chen, Xiaoqing Wu, Na Lin, Hailong Huang, Liangpu Xu
pmc-12450383.description: BackgroundStudies on the use of noninvasive prenatal testing (NIPT) in pregnancies conceived by in vitro fertilization (IVF) remain inadequate. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of NIPT in singleton pregnancies conceived by IVF and to compare it with that in naturally conceived (NC) pregnancies.MethodsA retrospective analysis was performed on 86397 pregnancies (IVF=3723, NC=82674).

pmc-12564336.title: Heart at Hand: The Role of Point-of-Care Cardiac Ultrasound in Internal Medicine
pmc-12564336.creator: Piero Tarantini, Francesco Cei, Fabiola Longhi, Aldo Fici, Salvatore Tupputi, Gino Solitro, Lucia Colavolpe, Stefania Marengo, Nicola Mumoli
pmc-12564336.description: Bedside echocardiography stands as a cornerstone diagnostic tool in internal medicine, offering rapid, real-time evaluation of cardiac structure and function across a wide spectrum of acute and chronic conditions. Its application, particularly when combined with lung and inferior vena cava (IVC) ultrasound, significantly enhances diagnostic accuracy for fluid balance assessment, dyspnea, and hypotensive states, guiding timely therapeutic decisions.

pmc-13146052.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A772 TEN YEARS OF ENDOVASCULAR THROMBECTOMY IN NORTHERN NEW ZEALAND
pmc-13146052.creator: Su Naing, Daniel Wellington, Joseph Donnelly, Jae Hong, William Diprose, Lily Zhao, Peter Barber
pmc-13146052.description: Background and aimsOur center participated in one of the pivotal trials that showed endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) in large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke patients improves functional outcome. We report 10-year trends and outcomes from our center, which provides EVT to 2.8 million people in northern New Zealand.

pmc-13324292.title: Association of IgG N-Glycans With Adverse Outcomes in CKD
pmc-13324292.creator: Elena Butz, Miriam IJ Bach, Fruzsina Kotsis, Inga Steinbrenner, Tamara Štambuk, Ivan Gudelj, Barbara Radovani Trbojević, Tea Pribić, Anika Mijakovac, Jennifer Nadal, Kai-Uwe Eckardt, Gordan Lauc, Anna Köttgen, Peggy Sekula, Ulla T Schultheiss, GCKD Investigators
pmc-13324292.description: IntroductionIgG N-glycosylation modulates inflammation and may influence chronic kidney disease (CKD). We investigated associations between IgG N-glycan patterns, kidney function, mortality, and kidney failure (KF) within the German CKD (GCKD) study.MethodsIgG N-glycan peaks were measured using ultrahigh-performance liquid chromatography in 4782 GCKD participants (estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR]: 30–60 ml/min per 1.73 m2 or overt albuminuria).

pmc-13345396.title: Can LLMs improve the accuracy of behavior prediction for personnel in high-stakes scenarios by predicting emotions? — A fine-tuning study based on scarce homogeneous cultural data in high-pressure environments
pmc-13345396.creator: Yibo Chen, Yang Ping, Shuhang Zhou, Caleb Jojo
pmc-13345396.description: Research on human behavior prediction using LLMs is increasingly prevalent. This study addresses a key question in the interdisciplinary fields of behavioral science and artificial intelligence: Can LLMs enhance the accuracy of predicting personnel behavior by predicting emotions in high-pressure scenarios?

pmc-13415297.title: A shorter path to circumventing the low reproducibility of SERS spectra through variable screening and optimization methodologies
pmc-13415297.creator: Antonio Morais Neto, Maycom Cezar Valeriano, Paula Homem-de-Mello, Bruno Guzzo da Silva, Mónica Benicia Mamián-López

pmc-13508696.title: Metabolic crisis and TRPM4 activation cause QT prolongation in TANGO2 deficiency disorder
pmc-13508696.creator: Lili Wang, Kyungsoo Kim, Prince J Kannankeril, Chen Zheng, Daniel J Blackwell, Samuel J Mackenzie, Paul S Brookes, Björn C Knollmann

pmc-13682390.title: Strategic intelligence and organizational ambidexterity for strengthening health system performance in a public healthcare network
pmc-13682390.creator: Mohammad Khalilzadeh, Zahra Rajaei, Sayyid Ali Banihashemi
pmc-13682390.description: This study examines the association between strategic intelligence (SI) and organizational ambidexterity (OA) in a public healthcare network, with attention to the two dimensions of OA: exploratory innovation (innovation, experimentation, and adaptation) and exploitative innovation (refinement, efficiency, and execution of existing competencies). OA was modeled as a latent variable indicated by the exploratory and exploitative innovation dimension scores.
